generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers all SOX in-scope processes and their mapped key controls in AuditBoard.
generic.In-scope period: Current fiscal year control inventory as of the assessment cutoff date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each risk in the taxonomy shows a mapped control ID or an explicit gap flag.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Control inventory count in AuditBoard matches the enterprise risk taxonomy count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coverage assessment memo saved to AuditBoard with assessment date and reviewer name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each coverage gap logged in the gap tracker with owner and target close date.
generic.Test population: All risks in the enterprise risk taxonomy with SOX or regulatory relevance.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every in-scope risk maps to at least one documented key control.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped risks route to the SOX Program Manager for remediation planning.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coverage assessment memo signed off by the SOX Program Manager before filing.
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard control coverage assessment folder, current fiscal year.

steps.title: Pull the control inventory export from AuditBoard
sop: Open AuditBoard and export the current key control inventory list.
Confirm the export includes control ID, owner, process and risk mapping fields.
Done when the control inventory export is saved for the assessment.
verify: Check the export row count against the AuditBoard control count.
Pass when the export matches the live AuditBoard inventory count.

steps.title: Compare control inventory against the risk taxonomy
sop: Open the enterprise risk taxonomy in the GRC platform.
Match each taxonomy risk against the exported control inventory by risk ID.
Flag any risk with no mapped control record.
Done when every taxonomy risk is marked mapped or flagged as a gap.
verify: Spot-check five flagged gaps against the control register.
Pass when flagged gaps genuinely lack a mapped control.

steps.title: Cross-reference SOX in-scope processes against the control register
sop: Pull the SOX in-scope process list from the GRC platform.
Confirm each process has at least one documented key control in the register.
Note any process lacking a key control as a coverage gap.
Done when every in-scope process is checked against the register.
verify: Recheck any process marked as lacking a control against AuditBoard.
Pass when the gap list reflects only genuinely uncovered processes.

steps.title: Review the prior-year coverage gap log for closure status
sop: Open the prior-year control gap tracker in AuditBoard.
Confirm each prior-year item is marked closed or carried forward with an owner.
Flag any item with neither status as unresolved.
Done when every prior-year gap has a current disposition.
verify: Confirm carried-forward items appear in the current gap tracker.
Pass when all prior-year items show a valid disposition.

steps.title: Log newly identified coverage gaps in the control gap tracker
sop: Create a new record in the GRC platform gap tracker for each newly identified gap.
Populate the risk, process, and severity fields for each new record.
Assign a target close date to each new gap record.
Done when all newly identified gaps are logged with a target date.
verify: Count new gap records against the flagged gap list from steps 2 and 3.
Pass when every flagged gap has a corresponding tracker record.

steps.title: Draft the annual control coverage assessment memo
sop: Summarize the coverage assessment scope, method, and results in the memo template.
List the newly identified and carried-forward gaps with owners and target dates.
Attach the reconciled inventory and taxonomy comparison as supporting exhibits.
Done when the memo draft covers scope, results, and all gap references.
verify: Compare the memo's gap count against the gap tracker record count.
Pass when the memo's counts reconcile to the tracker.

steps.title: Route the coverage assessment memo to the SOX Program Manager for sign-off
sop: Submit the completed memo to the SOX Program Manager via the GRC platform workflow.
Review the memo's findings, gap list, and supporting exhibits.
Sign off electronically once satisfied gaps are logged and owned.
Done when the SOX Program Manager's sign-off is recorded in the workflow.
verify: Confirm the sign-off timestamp and reviewer name appear in AuditBoard.
Pass when the signed memo is filed in the coverage assessment folder.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers all open control gap records requiring a new control design owner.
generic.In-scope period: Current control gap tracker as of the assignment cycle cutoff.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each gap record shows a named owner, title, and target implementation date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of assigned gap records matches the total open gap count in the tracker.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Owner acceptance and assignment date captured in the GRC platform workflow.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Gaps without a confirmed owner after follow-up logged as escalation candidates.
generic.Test population: All control gap tracker records with status Open at cycle start.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when 100% of open gap records carry an accepted named owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Unaccepted assignments after five business days escalate to the SOX Program Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignment closed only after the owner accepts the task in the GRC workflow.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform control gap tracker, owner assignment field history.

steps.title: Open the control gap tracker in the GRC platform
sop: Filter the control gap tracker to records with status Open.
Confirm each record lists the risk, process, and gap description.
Done when the open gap list for the assignment cycle is confirmed.
verify: Compare the filtered count against the total gap tracker record count.
Pass when the open list contains only unassigned gap records.

steps.title: Assign a named implementation owner to each gap record
sop: Enter the named individual and target implementation date on each gap record.
Select the owner's business unit and role from the GRC platform lookup.
Done when every open gap record shows a named owner and date.
verify: Spot-check five records for a populated owner and date field.
Pass when all sampled records show both fields populated.

steps.title: Route the assignment to the owner's manager for capacity confirmation
sop: Send the assignment record to the owner's manager via the GRC workflow.
Request confirmation the owner has capacity to deliver by the target date.
Done when a capacity confirmation request is logged for every assignment.
verify: Check the workflow log for a sent confirmation request per record.
Pass when every assignment shows a logged manager request.

steps.title: Update the gap tracker status field to Owner Assigned
sop: Change the status field from Open to Owner Assigned for each confirmed record.
Verify the status change timestamp is captured by the GRC platform.
Done when all assigned records show status Owner Assigned.
verify: Query the tracker for any Open record with a populated owner field.
Pass when no such mismatched records remain.

steps.title: Notify the assigned owner with the control design brief attached
sop: Trigger the GRC workflow notification task to the assigned owner.
Attach the control design brief document to the notification.
Done when a notification task is created for every assigned owner.
verify: Confirm the design brief attachment appears on each notification task.
Pass when every owner's task includes the attached brief.

steps.title: Confirm owner acceptance before closing the assignment task
sop: Review the GRC workflow for owner acceptance responses.
Follow up with any owner who has not responded within the SLA window.
Close the assignment task only after acceptance is recorded.
Done when every assignment task shows a recorded acceptance.
verify: Run the acceptance completion report for the assignment cycle.
Pass when 100% of assignments show accepted status before closure.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers every key control identified for entry into the AuditBoard control register.
generic.In-scope period: Current fiscal year control catalogue as of the register build cutoff.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each register record shows control ID, description, owner, frequency and control type.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register record count reconciles to the approved control inventory count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: RACM extract and control narrative attached with the entry date on each record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Controls missing a required field logged as data-quality exceptions with an owner.
generic.Test population: All key controls identified for the current control framework baseline.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every key control record carries all five standardized fields.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete records route back to the control owner for the missing detail.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Register sign-off granted only when the count reconciles to the approved inventory.
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard control register, current fiscal year catalogue build.

steps.title: Enter each key control into the AuditBoard control register
sop: Create a new register record for each key control with a unique control ID.
Populate the description, owner, frequency and control type fields.
Done when every key control has an active AuditBoard register record.
verify: Count the new register records against the key control list.
Pass when the register record count matches the key control list.

steps.title: Tag each control with process, risk and assertion
sop: Open each register record and select its associated process node.
Link the record to the risk and financial statement assertion it addresses.
Done when every record shows a process, risk and assertion tag.
verify: Spot-check ten records for populated process risk and assertion tags.
Pass when all sampled records show the three tags populated.

steps.title: Attach the control narrative and RACM extract
sop: Upload the control narrative document to the register record.
Attach the relevant RACM extract as supporting documentation.
Done when every record carries both attachments.
verify: Open five records and confirm both attachments are present.
Pass when all sampled records show narrative and RACM attached.

steps.title: Verify control frequency matches its actual operating cadence
sop: Compare the register's frequency field against the control narrative's stated cadence.
Correct any mismatch between the recorded and actual frequency.
Done when every record's frequency field matches its actual cadence.
verify: Recheck a sample of corrected records against the narrative.
Pass when sampled frequency fields match the narrative cadence.

steps.title: Reconcile register record count to the approved control inventory
sop: Pull the approved control inventory count from the control framework baseline.
Compare it against the current AuditBoard register record count.
Investigate and resolve any variance before sign-off.
Done when the register count reconciles to the approved inventory.
verify: Recompute both counts independently.
Pass when the two counts match exactly.

steps.title: Route the completed register for sign-off
sop: Submit the reconciled register to the SOX Program Manager for review.
Confirm all fields, attachments and reconciliation are complete.
Sign off on the register as the current control catalogue baseline.
Done when sign-off is recorded against the register version.
verify: Check the register version history for the sign-off entry.
Pass when the signed-off version is filed as current baseline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers the design-effectiveness rating scale and deficiency-severity thresholds for all key controls.
generic.In-scope period: Rating criteria apply to the control framework baseline for the current fiscal year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rating scale and severity thresholds each carry a definition and quantitative basis.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of rating levels and threshold tiers matches the approved PCAOB AS 2201 categories.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved criteria document filed in Archer GRC with version and approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Draft criteria rejected by the steering committee logged with requested changes.
generic.Test population: All key control register entries subject to design-effectiveness rating.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the steering committee approves the rating scale and thresholds without open conditions.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved committee comments route back to the SOX Program Manager for redraft.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Criteria considered final only after steering committee sign-off is recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Archer GRC control register field definitions, rating criteria document.

steps.title: Draft the design-effectiveness rating scale
sop: Define the effective, partially effective, and ineffective rating categories.
Write a definition for each rating category tied to control performance evidence.
Done when the draft rating scale with definitions is complete.
verify: Review the draft against PCAOB AS 2201 rating concepts.
Pass when each rating category has a clear, testable definition.

steps.title: Set deficiency-severity thresholds in Archer GRC
sop: Define the deficiency, significant deficiency, and material weakness threshold tiers.
Align the tier definitions with PCAOB AS 2201 guidance language.
Done when all three severity tiers are drafted with definitions.
verify: Compare the tier definitions against the PCAOB AS 2201 reference text.
Pass when the tiers align with the referenced guidance.

steps.title: Document quantitative materiality thresholds
sop: Tie misstatement magnitude ranges to each deficiency-severity tier.
Reference the current materiality figures from the audit planning workpaper.
Done when quantitative thresholds are documented for every tier.
verify: Cross-check the documented thresholds against the audit materiality workpaper.
Pass when the thresholds match the current materiality figures.

steps.title: Circulate the draft rating criteria to the SOX steering committee
sop: Send the draft rating scale and thresholds document to the steering committee.
Request written comments within the defined review window.
Done when the draft is circulated with a documented review deadline.
verify: Confirm receipt acknowledgment from each steering committee member.
Pass when all committee members confirm receipt before the deadline.

steps.title: Incorporate committee feedback and finalize the criteria
sop: Review the committee's comments against the draft criteria.
Update the rating scale and thresholds to address each comment.
Done when the criteria document reflects all resolved comments.
verify: Trace each committee comment to its resolution in the final document.
Pass when no committee comment remains unresolved.

steps.title: Publish the approved criteria to the control register field definitions
sop: Update the Archer GRC control register field definitions with the approved scale and thresholds.
Confirm the published version number and approval date are recorded.
Done when the register field definitions reflect the approved criteria.
verify: Open the register field definitions and confirm the new values display.
Pass when the published fields match the approved criteria document.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers the full control framework taxonomy from domain down to individual control.
generic.In-scope period: Framework structure applies to the current-year control register baseline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each taxonomy level and numbering code follows the defined domain-process-subprocess-control scheme.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: All 17 COSO principles mapped to at least one framework domain.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Framework charter filed in the GRC platform with version and approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Domains lacking a COSO principle mapping logged as charter gaps for correction.
generic.Test population: All COSO 2013 components and principles relevant to the enterprise control framework.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when all 17 COSO principles are mapped and the charter is steering-committee approved.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped principles route back to the SOX Program Manager for taxonomy revision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Charter considered final only once steering committee sign-off is on file.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform control framework charter, current approved version.

steps.title: Define the taxonomy hierarchy in the GRC platform
sop: Draft the domain, process, sub-process, and control hierarchy levels.
Align each hierarchy level to the corresponding COSO 2013 component.
Done when the four-level taxonomy hierarchy is drafted.
verify: Review the hierarchy against the COSO 2013 component structure.
Pass when each level maps cleanly to a COSO component.

steps.title: Assign the standardized control numbering scheme
sop: Define the numbering pattern, for example FIN-001 or CLM-014, by domain prefix.
Apply the numbering scheme to a sample set of existing controls.
Done when the numbering scheme is documented and sample-tested.
verify: Check the sample controls for numbering pattern consistency.
Pass when all sampled controls follow the defined pattern.

steps.title: Map the 17 COSO principles to framework domains
sop: List all 17 COSO 2013 principles against the defined framework domains.
Assign each principle to at least one domain based on control coverage.
Done when every COSO principle has an assigned domain.
verify: Count the mapped principles against the full list of 17.
Pass when all 17 principles show a domain assignment.

steps.title: Document the framework structure in the control framework charter
sop: Write the charter section describing the taxonomy, numbering scheme and principle mapping.
Attach the taxonomy diagram and mapping table as charter exhibits.
Done when the charter document is drafted with all required sections.
verify: Review the charter draft for completeness against the required sections.
Pass when taxonomy, numbering, and mapping sections are all present.

steps.title: Circulate the charter to the SOX steering committee for review
sop: Send the draft charter to the steering committee for comment.
Log received comments against the relevant charter section.
Done when all committee comments are logged for the charter.
verify: Confirm every committee member's comments are logged or a no-comment response received.
Pass when all committee members have responded.

steps.title: Obtain steering committee sign-off on the framework charter
sop: Incorporate committee comments into the final charter version.
Present the final charter for formal steering committee approval.
Record the approval decision and date in the charter version history.
Done when the sign-off is recorded against the current charter version.
verify: Check the charter version history for the recorded sign-off.
Pass when the current version shows a dated steering committee approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers control design documentation for every key control in the register.
generic.In-scope period: Design documentation reflects the control's current fiscal-year operating design.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each control record shows an objective, description and evidence requirement field.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Number of documented controls matches the total key control count in AuditBoard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Owner confirmation date recorded on the control design record before publishing.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Controls missing a design element logged as documentation gaps for the analyst.
generic.Test population: All key controls listed in the AuditBoard control register.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every key control record has objective, description and evidence documented.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete design records route back to the drafting analyst for completion.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documentation published only after the control owner confirms accuracy.
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard control register, control design documentation fields.

steps.title: Draft the control objective statement
sop: Identify the risk the control is designed to mitigate.
Write a concise objective statement linking the control to that risk.
Done when every key control has a drafted objective statement.
verify: Read five objective statements against their linked risk.
Pass when each statement clearly ties to its risk.

steps.title: Document the control description in AuditBoard
sop: Describe who performs the control and what evidence it generates.
Add the review or approval step that completes the control cycle.
Done when the description covers performer, evidence, and review step.
verify: Check a sample of descriptions for all three required elements.
Pass when sampled descriptions include performer, evidence and review.

steps.title: Specify the evidence requirements for testing
sop: List the specific evidence type, such as system report, sign-off or reconciliation, needed to test the control.
Confirm the evidence type is obtainable from the control's supporting application.
Done when every control record specifies its required evidence type.
verify: Confirm sampled evidence types match what the control's application can produce.
Pass when sampled evidence requirements are realistic and specific.

steps.title: Record the control's key attributes in AuditBoard
sop: Enter frequency, control type, automated/manual status and IT-dependency on the record.
Confirm each attribute matches the control narrative source document.
Done when all four key attributes are recorded for every control.
verify: Spot-check attribute fields against the source control narrative.
Pass when sampled attributes match the narrative.

steps.title: Route the design documentation to the control owner for confirmation
sop: Send the completed design documentation to the control owner via AuditBoard workflow.
Request the owner confirm accuracy of the objective, description and evidence fields.
Follow up on any unconfirmed record before the publishing deadline.
Done when every control record shows owner confirmation.
verify: Check the workflow log for confirmation status on all records.
Pass when 100% of control records show owner-confirmed status.

steps.title: Publish the confirmed control design documentation
sop: Mark each owner-confirmed record as published in AuditBoard.
Verify the publishing date is captured on the record.
Done when every confirmed control shows a published design record.
verify: Run the publication status report across all key controls.
Pass when all key controls show published design documentation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers control gaps identified against the current control framework taxonomy.
generic.In-scope period: Gaps reflect the current monitoring or assessment cycle in which they were found.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each gap record shows risk, process, severity and description fields populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged gap count matches the number of deficiencies identified during the review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Gap record includes the supporting evidence reference and log date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Gaps rejected during validation logged with the reason and resubmission owner.
generic.Test population: All control deficiencies identified during the current assessment or monitoring cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every identified gap is logged with risk, process, severity and evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: Unvalidated or disputed gaps route to the control framework owner for resolution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Gap log entry considered final only after framework owner validation.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform control gap tracker, current assessment cycle.

steps.title: Log each identified control gap in the GRC platform tracker
sop: Create a new gap record for each deficiency identified during the review.
Populate the risk, process and severity fields for the record.
Done when every identified gap has a new tracker record.
verify: Count new tracker records against the identified deficiency list.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Describe the control deficiency and supporting evidence
sop: Write a description of the specific design or operating deficiency observed.
Attach or reference the evidence supporting the finding.
Done when every gap record has a description and evidence reference.
verify: Read five gap descriptions against their attached evidence.
Pass when the description and evidence are consistent.

steps.title: Cross-reference each gap to its control register entry
sop: Link the gap record to the affected control register entry in AuditBoard.
Confirm the linked control ID matches the deficiency description.
Done when every gap record shows a linked control register entry.
verify: Spot-check five gap-to-control links for accuracy.
Pass when sampled links correctly identify the affected control.

steps.title: Assign a preliminary risk rating to each gap
sop: Apply the preliminary risk rating scale to each newly logged gap.
Base the rating on likelihood and potential financial statement impact.
Done when every gap record shows a preliminary risk rating.
verify: Recheck a sample of ratings against the rating scale criteria.
Pass when sampled ratings are consistent with the criteria.

steps.title: Route the gap log to the control framework owner for validation
sop: Submit the completed gap log to the control framework owner for review.
Review each gap for completeness of risk, process, severity and evidence fields.
Confirm or return disputed gaps with comments.
Done when every gap in the log is validated or returned with comments.
verify: Check the validation status field on every gap record.
Pass when all gaps show a validated or resolved status.

steps.title: Finalize the validated gap log for remediation planning
sop: Update the tracker status for validated gaps to ready for remediation.
File the finalized gap log version in the GRC platform.
Done when all validated gaps are marked ready for remediation.
verify: Confirm the finalized log's gap count matches the validated count.
Pass when the filed log reflects only validated gap records.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers all pending change requests against the AuditBoard control register.
generic.In-scope period: Register reflects changes processed during the current maintenance cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each processed control shows updated owner, frequency and description fields.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register control count reconciles to the prior period count with variances explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change request processing date recorded on each affected register record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Change requests rejected as invalid logged with the reason and requester notified.
generic.Test population: All change requests submitted to the control register queue this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the register completeness report shows every active process mapped.
generic.Exception handling path: Processes with no mapped control after the run escalate to the SOX Program Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Register considered current only after the completeness report shows zero gaps.
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard control register, current maintenance cycle change log.

steps.title: Process pending change requests in the AuditBoard register queue
sop: Open the pending change request queue in AuditBoard.
Apply each new, retired, or modified control change to the register.
Done when the change request queue is fully processed.
verify: Confirm the queue shows zero pending change requests remaining.
Pass when all submitted requests have been applied.

steps.title: Update owner, frequency and description fields for changed controls
sop: Identify controls affected by organizational or process changes.
Update the owner, frequency and description fields to reflect the change.
Done when all affected controls show updated field values.
verify: Spot-check five updated controls against the source change request.
Pass when sampled fields match the requested change.

steps.title: Retire controls tied to decommissioned processes
sop: Identify controls linked to processes marked as decommissioned.
Set the control status to retired with a retirement rationale and date.
Done when every decommissioned-process control shows retired status.
verify: Confirm retired controls no longer appear in the active register view.
Pass when all decommissioned-process controls are marked retired.

steps.title: Run the register completeness report
sop: Execute the completeness report comparing active processes to mapped controls.
Review the output for any active process with zero mapped controls.
Done when the completeness report has been run and reviewed.
verify: Confirm the report output lists zero unmapped active processes.
Pass when no active process shows a missing control mapping.

steps.title: Reconcile the register control count to the prior period
sop: Pull the prior period's control register count for comparison.
Compare it against the current register count and identify the variance.
Document an explanation for any variance identified.
Done when the count reconciliation and variance explanation are complete.
verify: Recompute the variance independently from the two period counts.
Pass when the documented variance matches the recomputed figure.

steps.title: Confirm the maintained register with the SOX Program Manager
sop: Review the processed changes, completeness report and reconciliation.
Confirm no unresolved change requests or completeness gaps remain.
Sign off on the register as current for the maintenance cycle.
Done when sign-off is recorded for the current register version.
verify: Check the register version history for the recorded sign-off.
Pass when the current version is confirmed and dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers all applicable regulatory obligations for in-scope legal entities.
generic.In-scope period: Mapping reflects the regulatory obligation list as of the current baseline date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each obligation record shows at least one linked control objective.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Mapped obligation count reconciles to the total obligation count in the regulatory library.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mapping table published to the GRC library with version and publish date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmapped obligations logged as framework coverage gaps with a remediation owner.
generic.Test population: All regulatory obligations applicable to the in-scope legal entities.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every applicable obligation maps to at least one control objective.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped obligations route to the Controls Analyst for framework remediation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mapping considered complete only after citation currency is verified.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform regulatory library, obligation-to-control-objective map.

steps.title: Pull the applicable regulatory obligations list
sop: Query the GRC regulatory library for obligations applicable to in-scope legal entities.
Export the obligation list with citation and effective date fields.
Done when the applicable obligations list is exported.
verify: Confirm the export count matches the regulatory library's in-scope filter count.
Pass when the two counts match.

steps.title: Link each obligation to one or more control objectives
sop: Open the framework mapping table in Archer GRC.
Add a link from each obligation to its corresponding control objective or objectives.
Done when every obligation on the list has at least one linked objective.
verify: Spot-check ten obligation links for logical fit to the control objective.
Pass when sampled links are appropriate and documented.

steps.title: Flag obligations with no mapped control objective
sop: Identify obligations remaining unlinked after the mapping pass.
Flag each as a coverage gap in the framework mapping table.
Done when all unlinked obligations are flagged as gaps.
verify: Run a query for obligations with zero linked objectives.
Pass when the query returns only the flagged gap list.

steps.title: Verify mapped citations reference the current regulation version
sop: Compare each mapped citation against the regulatory change log for updates.
Correct citations referencing a superseded regulation version.
Done when all mapped citations reference the current version.
verify: Spot-check five citations against the regulatory change log.
Pass when sampled citations match the current regulation version.

steps.title: Route flagged coverage gaps for framework remediation
sop: Send the flagged unmapped obligations list to the Controls Analyst.
Confirm each flagged item is logged in the control gap tracker.
Done when all flagged obligations appear in the gap tracker.
verify: Cross-check the flagged list against the gap tracker entries.
Pass when every flagged obligation has a corresponding gap record.

steps.title: Publish the completed mapping to the GRC library
sop: Review the finalized obligation-to-control-objective map for completeness.
Publish the map to the GRC library as the current framework baseline.
Done when the published map version is recorded in the library.
verify: Open the GRC library and confirm the published map is accessible.
Pass when the published version date matches the review date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scope covers the full control framework baseline package for governance review.
generic.In-scope period: Baseline package reflects the current fiscal year's approved framework version.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Package includes taxonomy, register extract and rating criteria in the review packet.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Package section count matches the required governance packet checklist.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed approval memo filed in Archer GRC with the sign-off date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conditions attached to approval logged with an owner and resolution deadline.
generic.Test population: The full control framework baseline as submitted to the steering committee.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the steering committee records unconditional or condition-tracked approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Conditional approvals route to the Controls Analyst to resolve before finalization.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Baseline considered approved only once the signed memo is filed.
generic.Evidence location: Archer GRC governance folder, control framework baseline approval record.

steps.title: Assemble the control framework baseline package
sop: Compile the taxonomy document, register extract and rating criteria.
Confirm each component reflects the most current approved draft.
Done when the baseline package is assembled and internally consistent.
verify: Check each package component's version date for consistency.
Pass when all components carry the same baseline version date.

steps.title: Present the baseline package to the SOX steering committee
sop: Schedule the presentation slot on the steering committee agenda.
Walk the committee through the taxonomy, register and rating criteria.
Record discussion points raised during the session.
Done when the presentation is delivered and discussion is recorded.
verify: Review the meeting minutes for recorded discussion points.
Pass when minutes capture the presentation and discussion.

steps.title: Capture the committee's approval decision and conditions
sop: Record the committee's approve, conditionally approve, or reject decision.
Note any conditions attached to a conditional approval.
Done when the decision and any conditions are documented.
verify: Confirm the recorded decision matches the meeting minutes.
Pass when the documented decision and minutes agree.

steps.title: File the signed approval memo in Archer GRC
sop: Prepare the approval memo reflecting the committee's decision.
Obtain the required signature and upload the memo to Archer GRC.
Done when the signed memo is filed against the baseline version.
verify: Open Archer GRC and confirm the signed memo is attached.
Pass when the filed memo matches the recorded committee decision.

steps.title: Update the framework version history
sop: Add a new entry to the framework version history log.
Record the approved baseline date and any conditions.
Done when the version history reflects the approved baseline.
